outcome: coagulation function indicators (activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT), prothrombin time (PT), fibrinogen (FIB), D-dimer (D-D), platelet count (PLT), plasma viscosity (PV), whole blood high shear viscosity (HBV), whole blood low shear viscosity (LBV), erythrocyte deformability index (EDI))
lower extremity venous blood flow velocity (femoral deep vein, popliteal vein, posterior tibial vein)
cohort: The study included 172 high-risk parturients undergoing cesarean section.
finding: Enoxaparin sodium effectively improved postpartum coagulation function and reduced the incidence of lower extremity DVT in high-risk parturients undergoing cesarean section.
mod_finding: Enoxaparin sodium effectively reduced the incidence of lower extremity DVT in high-risk parturients undergoing cesarean section.
